item.title: Chicago White Sox Fan Pope Leo on Team's Playoff Run
item.description: Chicago White Sox superfan Pope Leo was asked if he had anything to do with their playoff "miracle" as the team prepares to face Cleveland on Saturday.

item.description: The tigers stayed inside the enclosure and the public was not at risk.

item.title: At least 4 dead as Isaias threatens Southeast floods
